Q986615: The Monetary Authority of Macao (Chinese: 澳門金融管理局; Portuguese: Autoridade Monetária de Macau, AMCM) is the currency board and the de facto central bank of Macau. Q16711016: The Belogorsk Lion Safari-Park Taigan (Ukrainian: Белогорський сафарі-парк левів «Тайган», romanized: Belohorskyi safari-park leviv "Taigan") is a safari park in the Bilohirsk Raion of Crimea. It is the largest European breeding ground for lions and other large predator mammals.
